recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血中有幾顆小到中型淋巴球，其中兩顆的核有凹陷或輕度分葉（花瓣狀傾向），細胞質少、呈淡藍色；異常細胞不多、紅血球正常，符合冒煙型成人 T 細胞白血病/淋巴瘤的輕微表現。
features: Two cells with indented to mildly lobulated nuclei (incipient flower-cell morphology)
Low number of atypical cells in the field
Normochromic, normocytic RBCs; no significant poikilocytosis
Low magnification limits assessment of nuclear detail
describe_en: Low-power peripheral blood smear shows a few small-to-intermediate lymphocytes, two of which have indented to mildly lobulated nuclei with dense chromatin and scant agranular cytoplasm. Atypical cells are not numerous, and the red cells are unremarkable. Nuclear detail is limited at this magnification. In an HTLV-1-seropositive patient, findings are consistent with adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma, smoldering type, which requires at least 5% abnormal T cells with normal lymphocyte count, calcium, and LDH.

ddx.vs: Sézary cells have finely grooved cerebriform nuclei, and patients are HTLV-1-negative with erythroderma.
Chronic type has absolute lymphocytosis of at least 4 x 10^9/L, whereas smoldering type has normal lymphocyte counts.
Reactive lymphocytes have abundant cytoplasm and round nuclei and lack clonal HTLV-1 proviral integration.
Notched nuclei may be seen, but the cells are CD5+ cyclin D1+ B cells rather than CD4+CD25+ T cells.
